interface.name: flowwm_node_row_manager_v1

description.summary: commit node geometry with the canvas buffer

interface.description: Scene state is double buffered with the supplied canvas wl_surface. Updates travel on the canvas connection, before the matching wl_surface.commit. Geometry never requires a synchronous IPC round trip. Payloads use the NodeRowScene JSON schema. Large scenes are split into bounded chunks.

arg.name: reset
arg.summary: start a new scene when nonzero; otherwise append windows

arg.name: payload
arg.summary: NodeRowScene JSON; at most 16 windows per chunk
